items.title: Beyond Koplik spots: aphthous-like ulcers as a novel enanthem in adolescent and adult measles
items.summary: CONCLUSIONS: Aphthous-like oral ulcers are a frequent enanthem of measles that outlasts the Koplik window and warrants active recognition and prompt measles testing.
